formulas.description: Server group operating power. Aggregate matching AC-input operating power for servers.
formulas.boundary: One server figure includes GPUs/CPU/PSU; never add their TDP again.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Other IT power. Count powered network/storage once at the same IT meter boundary.
formulas.boundary: List all other IT classes; this worked example has only two.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Total operating IT power. Sum synchronized equipment load at one IT boundary.
formulas.boundary: A sum of selected operating values is a scenario estimate, not measured annual PUE denominator.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Rack maximum power demand. Aggregate only equipment allocated to this rack.
formulas.boundary: Other rack devices and simultaneous power basis must be explicit.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Sum-of-maxima planning envelope. Conservative arithmetic bound of listed equipment maxima.
formulas.boundary: Not observed coincident peak; source warns peaks may differ in time.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Rack limit arithmetic margin. Screen for rack limit exceedance using matching rating basis.
formulas.boundary: A positive result does not validate wiring, derating or redundancy.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: UPS AC input. Calculate upstream power at selected operating point.
formulas.boundary: Never take efficiency from another load/mode; do not add UPS loss again through PUE.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: UPS conversion loss. Quantify UPS dissipation entering facility overhead.
formulas.boundary: Heat location depends on physical placement; not all goes to IT room.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Apparent demand. Compare apparent load with equipment kVA rating.
formulas.boundary: PF belongs to same circuit/load; distortion and unbalanced phase design require separate check.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Balanced three-phase line current. Estimate line current from active load and matching line voltage.
formulas.boundary: Only balanced three-phase steady-state; code/thermal/short-circuit checks separate.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: UPS active rating margin. Check active power rating independently from apparent rating.
formulas.boundary: Not a safety factor or code compliance assessment.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: UPS apparent rating margin. Check apparent power rating independently.
formulas.boundary: Both kW and kVA margins must be examined.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Single-module-out capacity screen. Arithmetic capacity remaining after failure of largest unit.
formulas.boundary: Distribution path, UPS mode, shared failure and Tier status require separate topology evaluation.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Annual measured PUE. Compare matched annual facility and IT energy.
formulas.boundary: Annual measured category requires meter locations, scope and non-electric energy treatment.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Planning facility demand. Estimate facility electrical demand conditional on an approved factor at matching load/time.
formulas.boundary: An annual energy-based PUE is not automatically a design-peak multiplier.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Facility overhead demand. Show non-IT demand implicit in the chosen planning factor.
formulas.boundary: Includes UPS/cooling/lighting inside chosen boundary; do not add separately.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Annual non-IT energy. Measured annual overhead at consistent boundary.
formulas.boundary: Difference requires E_fac >= E_IT; if not, meter boundary/data issue.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: One interval energy. Integrate an interval mean power over matching elapsed hours.
formulas.source_location: NIST · Watt-hour to joule unit entry
formulas.boundary: Do not use instantaneous peak as interval mean.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Example 24-hour facility energy. Sum four nonoverlapping 6-hour interval energies.
formulas.boundary: Only a complete day if time coverage is 24 h without gaps.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Time-weighted average demand. Calculate representative power from total energy and covered hours.
formulas.boundary: If intervals differ, divide by sum of actual durations.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Conditional year energy projection. What-if annual energy if this 24-hour profile repeats every day.
formulas.source_location: NIST · Energy = power × time, derived scenario
formulas.boundary: Project assumption only; cannot be described as measured annual consumption.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: Daily interval coverage. Show whether the four example intervals cover a full day.
formulas.boundary: Continuous 24-h day requires no overlaps or gaps as well as numeric total.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C · SRS E5 / Handoff ENG-06

formulas.description: IT electrical load to heat. First-law room heat estimate for IT power dissipated in boundary.
formulas.boundary: Heat leaves via air/liquid/export paths; location and transients matter.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C heat handoff → Team B cooling selection

formulas.description: Air-side room heat. Allocate uncaptured IT heat and other room heat to air.
formulas.boundary: f_liquid must be measured/engineered, not a universal percentage.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C heat handoff → Team B cooling selection

formulas.description: Liquid-side captured heat. Allocate portion of IT heat delivered to liquid loop.
formulas.boundary: Assumes other room heat is air-side and no uncounted exports.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C heat handoff → Team B cooling selection

formulas.description: Total required room heat removal. Recombine mutually exclusive air and liquid loads for cooling planning.
formulas.boundary: Not PUE×IT power; non-IT outdoor plant losses do not all heat IT room.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C heat handoff → Team B cooling selection

formulas.description: Cooling after one-unit outage. Screen installed capacity after largest unit unavailable.
formulas.boundary: Individual ratings must hold at design temperatures and flow; paths shared failure matter.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C heat handoff → Team B cooling selection

formulas.description: Post-outage cooling utilization. Compare load and remaining matched cooling capacity.
formulas.boundary: If surviving=0, result blocked, never claim zero utilization.
formulas.owner_alias: Team C heat handoff → Team B cooling selection

formulas.description: Dry-air mass flow from sensible load. Find mass flow needed to transport stated sensible heat.
formulas.boundary: Property basis must match dry/moist air convention and actual state.
formulas.owner_alias: Team B cooling method; Team C provides IT heat input

formulas.description: Air volumetric flow. Convert mass flow at measured condition to volume flow.
formulas.boundary: Do not use sea-level density for elevated/hot site uncritically.
formulas.owner_alias: Team B cooling method; Team C provides IT heat input

formulas.description: Moist-air total heat transfer. Calculate total sensible plus latent heat from matching enthalpy states.
formulas.boundary: If humidity changes, Q_total can differ from sensible; enthalpy must share kg basis.
formulas.owner_alias: Team B cooling method; Team C provides IT heat input

formulas.description: Air latent remainder. Reconcile total and sensible heat under same air-stream boundary.
formulas.source_location: ASH25 · Chapter 18 sensible and latent equations
formulas.boundary: A negative result indicates mismatched properties or state/boundary; flag.
formulas.owner_alias: Team B cooling method; Team C provides IT heat input

formulas.description: Liquid mass flow needed. Size theoretical single-phase mass flow for heat transport.
formulas.boundary: No pump/head sizing or two-phase refrigerant; use mixture properties.
formulas.owner_alias: Team B method; Team C provides IT heat and facility energy

formulas.description: Liquid volume flow. Convert mass flow to liters per second at supplied density.
formulas.boundary: Flow is circulated water, not consumed water.
formulas.owner_alias: Team B method; Team C provides IT heat and facility energy

formulas.description: Heat capacity of selected liquid flow. Compare independently selected pump/CDU flow capacity to loop heat requirement.
formulas.boundary: Matched fluid, temperatures, branch routing and real flow measurement are required.
formulas.owner_alias: Team B method; Team C provides IT heat and facility energy

formulas.description: Cooling equipment electrical input. Conditional electric input at matching rated cooling condition.
formulas.source_location: ASHCOP · Cooling system energy COP entry
formulas.boundary: COP must include correct equipment/fan/pump boundary, not a fixed site value.
formulas.owner_alias: Team B method; Team C provides IT heat and facility energy

formulas.description: Hot-side heat-rejection balance. Account for cooling equipment input that enters specified rejection path.
formulas.source_location: ASHDC · Chapter 20 loop/heat-exchanger boundary, derived energy balance
formulas.boundary: Conditional: electrical losses may be rejected elsewhere; define equipment boundary.
formulas.owner_alias: Team B method; Team C provides IT heat and facility energy

formulas.description: Annual site WUE. Report annual site water per annual IT electricity with matched boundaries.
formulas.boundary: Not a water demand prediction from thermal load; site meter and scope required.
formulas.owner_alias: Team B method; Team C provides IT heat and facility energy
